tier_caveat: Tier 2 only. P2 measured tier agreement on fragility at Spearman 0.620 (n = 125) and concluded tier 2 cannot substitute for tier 1 when fragility is the quantity of interest. Tier 1 was not affordable for this corpus (P2 spent 124.5 CPU-hours on 125 strategies). These figures are not interchangeable with P2's published fragility.
